title: OmniShow: Unified Multimodal Human-Object Interaction Video Generation
summary: OmniShow is an end-to-end framework for generating high-fidelity videos of humans interacting with objects using images, audio, and poses. It specializes in precise motion control and lip-sync for e-commerce and digital avatar applications.
research_notes: Developed by ByteDance in collaboration with major research universities including CUHK and HKU.

evolution.summary: Launched in April 2026 for ICML, OmniShow introduced the RAP2V framework and the HOIVG-Bench evaluation benchmark. It currently stands as a primary solution for unified multimodal conditioning in video generation.
